snippet.title: Official First Reveal Teaser | Steel Swarm: Invasion
snippet.description:
From the creators of Steel Swarm: Apocalypse comes a new single-player action RPG set in a war-torn universe.

Brutal combat. Devastating vehicles. Deep customization.

Shape the story. Survive the invasion.
Wishlist now on Steam and help shape the future of the Steel Swarm universe.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3793260
